purpose: Accepted baseline for the WH-054 packet 1a body validators on the current schema. Cross-type findings are NOT defects of the current single-tenant schema: while every tenant is also an account they behave correctly. They are the exact worklist the coordinated C2 schema (packet 1b) must rewrite by hand, and 1b's exit requires this list to be empty. Fingerprints are stable across line moves and alias renames; a new finding or a finding that disappears fails the gate.

sqlSurface.allowlistPurpose: Every statement the syntax tree cannot resolve to fixed SQL text (a table name interpolated, or a non-literal argument) needs a reviewed entry. Reasons record what the source shows; they do not prove the value is unreachable by request data. A new dynamic site, or an entry that no longer matches, fails the gate.
